_doc: Anatomical limits + self-collision settings for the SMPL-X digital twin.
Read by the Python solver (src/camera/body_model.py) AND the Blender receiver, so both agree.
joint_limits_deg: per SMPL-X joint, Euler ranges in degrees in the joint's LOCAL frame.
SMPL-X local frames are world-aligned at rest: +X = body-left, +Y = up, +Z = forward.
order = Blender Euler order (first letter applied first). The middle axis must be the one
with the smallest range (keeps it away from gimbal lock). Only left_* and centre joints are
listed; right_* are mirrored automatically (x kept, y/z negated).
Sign cheat-sheet (left side): knee +x bends; hip -x flexes thigh forward, +z abducts;
shoulder +z raises arm, -y swings it forward; elbow -y bends; wrist -z flexes palm-down;
spine +x bends forward; ankle -x lifts toes.
collision: capsule proxies are derived from the mesh + skin weights. radius_scale < 1 lets skin
touch; slack_m is allowed overlap before the penalty starts.
